pageDescription: Effectively use elevation to establish hierarchy, separate layers, and bring focus to interactive surfaces.

principles.title: Visual Hierarchy
principles.body: Guide user attention and highlight priority content through depth.

principles.title: Subtle:
principles.body: Apply elevation to add dimensional feel without cluttering the UI.

principles.title: Focus
principles.body: Use opacity backgrounds to focus layered surfaces, such as modals.

shadow.title: Shadow
shadow.body: Provides spatial separation for transient overlay components (e.g., tooltips, dropdowns menu) and acts as an elevated hover response for interactive containers like tiles and cards.

opacities.title: Opacities
opacities.body: An opacity background can bring focus by increasing the visual contrast of a layered surface like modals and sheets.
